functions.plate_comment: Buffer-aware load under type-0 metadata and root mutex. States 0/5 or destination mismatch select ForcePersistLoad(0, filename(flag)). State 1 is an error: resets state/owner/mask to zero, model-version 2 aborts; otherwise returns false, NOT fallback file load. Other matching states (including unnamed 6) use buffer: same PID uses pointer, foreign PID opens task-index shm O_RDONLY and mmap(PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED). For each subscribed ID found in buffered descriptors: region lock, callback 0, memcpy recorded length, callback 1, unlock. Can succeed with newer data than file and without every subscribed ID present. Foreign-owner normal success has no local fd close or munmap: mmap success at 0x1ca28 branches via 0x1ca32/0x1ca3e to 0x1c778; close at 0x1ca4a is on failure path only; common restore exits at 0x1c84a..0x1c858 then 0x1c6f2..0x1c708. No munmap call in this function. Worker cleanup at 0x1d1e8..0x1d212 releases its own task mapping/fd, not the foreign loader locals. Static local-resource observation, not proven runtime leak rate, safe shutdown, disk freshness or durability.
